name: zflow-ui
description: Electron front end for ZFlow. The Swift app stays the engine; this is the settings and history surface.

scripts.build:main: esbuild main/index.ts main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outdir=dist-main --external:electron --external:sherpa-onnx-node && cp main/diarize-worker.js dist-main/
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
